text: Dispatch envelope from derive-synthesis iteration 2 to the end of the run, replacing intervention 0000 for every later stage. Each agent stage is dispatched by the new driver as one fresh Factory Droid subagent (the general-purpose 'worker' type) with no inherited conversation; its model is inherited from the driver session, which the host labels 'Opus 5.5' (exact API model identifier, context window and server revision unexposed), on Factory Droid CLI 0.236.0. Host deviation: this host exposes no exact per-dispatch reasoning-effort control. Its dispatch offers only the complexity tiers light, medium and heavy, each capped at the session's own level, so every remaining agent stage is dispatched at the highest tier, heavy, whether its packet declares high or xhigh. Declared high and xhigh stages are therefore not distinguished by this host, and neither is guaranteed to equal its declared level. Packet bytes, workflow digest and declared efforts are unchanged. Each worker is handed its packet by exact path and SHA-256 and reads it in full. The driver adds only: the result path, a worker-owned scratch directory, the checkout path, the model identity, host and declared effort with this deviation for generation provenance, the host note that Python Markdown 3.11 is installed while the repository pins 3.10.3 (with the pinned scratch virtualenv to put first on PATH), and the instruction that the driver alone runs git and tpt advance.
